title: Studio form designer: the disabled Move group up/down and field Move up arrows give no reason on hover, on keyboard focus or to assistive technology
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · acceptance[1]

Found by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`). Same class as #31493 and #31495, which pass on the same boot.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object:showcase_task` and go to the Form tab.
2. The "Task" group header buttons `aria-label="Move group up"` and `aria-label="Move group down"` are both disabled, because the form has one group.
3. Hover either one: no `[role=tooltip]` and no adjacent text appears. Press Tab from the top: neither is reached. Each is a native `disabled` button at 30% opacity, with no title, no aria-describedby and no focusable wrapper.
4. The same class appears off-clause: on a writable package, select the first field. The field inspector's "Move up" is disabled with `title="Move up"` (a name, not a reason), and Tab cannot reach it.

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

**Expected:** a disabled control says why on hover and on keyboard focus, through a focusable wrapper with aria-describedby naming the reason (for example "Already the first group").

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`: the group header buttons with `disabled={!canMoveUp}` and `disabled={!canMoveDown}` (around lines 656 and 665) have no disabled-reason wrapper.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormCanvas.tsx` (around lines 958 and 967) uses the same pattern for fields.

Owning package: `@object-ui/app-shell`.
